answer: Each new agent posts a $500 burnable bond and needs one vouch from an established agent whose own $500 stake backs it. Cheat once, both bonds burn. A 1,000-identity sybil army locks $1M plus vouches honest agents won't sell cheap — the attack dies at the gate before it moves. Like juniper roots holding a hillside, each identity anchors others; a lone sparrow raiding at dawn grabs one seed, never the field.
